links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT-generated kidney transplant brochures for caregivers, teens, and children
links.effect: Caregiver and teen brochures were at grades 9-14; child brochures at grades 6-11, above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Generated caregiver and teen materials achieved readability levels of grades 9-14, while child-specific brochures achieved readability levels of grades 6-11.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-generated patient education brochures for kidney transplant, evaluated by expert panel, patient/caregiver, and standard readability/understandability metrics.
